name: Fuuki Iinchou Katagiri Hazuki!! Minna ga Miteru Mae de Shojo made Ubawareru Nante...!!
original_name: 風紀委員長 片桐葉月!! みんなが見てる前で処女まで奪われるなんて…!!
source: Katagiri Hazuki over practices her Karate club leading to resentment from her club members. The protagonist then hears a rumor about Hazuki's father racking up debt, and uses this to rape her with the help of his fellow clubmates.
translation: 片桐叶月因练习空手道俱乐部而导致俱乐部成员的不满。随后，主角听到了有关叶月的父亲负债累累的谣言，并利用这一点在其他俱乐部成员的帮助下强奸了她。
